column1: # Slots ruled out BY DESIGN, read by util/lexicon_completeness.py: a (lemme, cgram, slot) matching a row below gets the status
# "excluded:<reason>" in the completeness census, even if a conjugation template or a NOM/ADJ paradigm defines it. They are not
#   lemme  a lemma, or * for every lemma.
#   slot   VER: a tag as in the infover column (ind:pre:1s, inf, par:pre) or par:pas:<m|f><s|p) (par:pas:ms); NOM/ADJ: <m|f><s|p> (ms).
#          A trailing * matches a prefix (sub:imp:* = the whole subjonctif imparfait; * alone = every slot).
#   reason a short code without spaces or tabs, after a free comment if needed (the census prints "excluded:<reason>").
# - sub:imp:*   subjonctif imparfait declared out of scope for the theory on 2026-09-21 (archaic, literary tense; src/verbparadigm.py
# - neiger, bruiner (and other weather verbs): 1st and 2nd person impossible, util/fixDeleteWeatherVerbErrors.py (neiges sub:pre:2s,
#   bruinasse sub:imp:1s deleted). The templates (grêl:er and the like) already leave these persons empty; the rows make the ruling explicit.
# - sourdre: strictly 3rd person, util/fixSourdreDefectiveGaps.py ("sourds" imp:pre:2s / ind:pre:1s deleted).
# - foutre, advenir, renaître, grêler: NOT excluded, util/fixFoutreDefectiveTenses.py, fixAdvenirRenaitreGaps.py and fixGrelerFigurativePlural.py
#   completed their templates (the slots exist), so nothing to list.
